newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-AFN, GME finds gold at Clermont.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-AFN, GME finds gold at Clermont.

text.p: Australian Gold Fields N.L. (AFN) and GME Resources N.L. said on Tuesday that initial results from a soil sampling programme near Clermont in Queensland had identified three broad zones of anomalous gold.
"Excellent potential for high grade gold veins exists at depth and along strike," GME and AFN said in a joint statement.
They said they had also entered into a joint venture agreement to develop the Clermont area after buying and consolidating exploration permits with a combined area of 1,152 square kilometres.

AFN has a 60 percent interest in the joint venture while GME has a 40 percent interest. The joint venture has an exploration spending programme worth A$885,000 planned for between January 1 this year and June 30, 1998.
